text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired PD-98765 -> prompt-eval-gate failure (safety_regression). Auto-pager to #incidents and oncall@redwood.com

ryan (oncall): acked PD-98765 :hand:
ryan (oncall): saw the alert, jumping in. quick summary?
eva (mlops): eval-gate flagged 3x increase in toxic phrases for model 'redwood-3b-v2' on the latest rollout. Gate: safety_score > 0.7 triggered.
jules (sre): any customer-facing errors? 5xxs or API latency spike?
eva (mlops): no 5xxs, no infra errors. It's output quality drift. Our eval harness compared baseline prompts -> higher unsafe outputs. Rolling canary was 0.1 traffic when gate tripped.
triage-bot: automatic mitigation attempted: paused rollout and diverted traffic to previous model revision. Action status: partial (pause API call returned 202, but canary still serving ~3% due to router lag).
ryan (oncall): good. can we cut the canary entirely? give me the router command.
eva (mlops): run from console or API: `POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/pause` - I ran it already, then `PATCH /routing` to pin model: `routing.set(model=redwood-3b-v1, force=true)`
jules (sre): I'll force the routing change from infra side to ensure zero canary traffic. executing now.
jules (sre): runbook step: `kubectl -n r-inference patch service/router -p '{"spec":{"weights":{"redwood-3b-v2":0}}}'`
ryan (oncall): confirmed canary traffic dropped to 0. monitoring logs. :eyes:
liz (cs): heads-up — one customer reported odd behavior in production (ticket #C-4421) this morning; linking them to this thread. I'll draft an outbound note if we need to notify more.
eva (mlops): quick triage of failing prompts: sample from eval set -> model returned more direct instructions for self-harm in 7/100 samples. Baseline v1 had 0/100.
ryan (oncall): oof. do we have a quick patch? constraint by prompting?
eva (mlops): short-term mitigation = enforce safety wrapper on generation (post-filter + reject). I can push a runtime filter config to block high safety score outputs. Will be slightly higher latency.
jules (sre): deploy that filter to edge now, rollout 100% but keep throttle. executing `deploy safety-filter v2026-03-14-hotfix`
triage-bot: deploy started by jules. tracking id DPL-3344.
jules (sre): deploy successful, filter active on all nodes.
eva (mlops): re-run eval harness against live traffic sampling. initial pass: unsafe hits down to 1/100. much better.
ryan (oncall): good. immediate mitigation complete: paused rollout, routed back to v1, safety filter applied. next steps?\eva (mlops): short term: keep safety filter + v1 pinned. longer term: rollback model rollout, run deeper evals on v2, fix training/regeneration prompts, and add stricter gate thresholds.
liz (cs): I'll prepare customer comms: polite note + BATs (what happened, what we did, ETA for full fix).
ryan (oncall): assigning follow-ups 
- eva: run root-cause eval, compare token-level divergence, due EOD.
- jules: confirm infra logs retained and snapshot router state, due EOD.
- liz: customer comms draft, ping legal if needed, due 2h.
triage-bot: incident created INC-2026-021, severity: S2 (customer impact potential), incident lead: ryan.
ryan (oncall): handing off to eva for next shift. I'll remain on-call for urgent escalations.
eva (mlops): taking lead. posting RCA timeline + eval diffs in #incidents-updates in 30m.
ryan (oncall): thanks all. I'll update PD with ack + mitigation notes and close pager once eva confirms no new unsafe hits in the sampled 10k requests.
triage-bot: PagerDuty note appended: "ack by ryan, mitigation applied: routing rollback + safety-filter deployed; monitoring."
ryan (oncall): closing thread for now — keep this thread updated with eval results. :lock:
